title: Report undecodable remote terminal origins as doctor findings
outcome: A remote origin object with the expected kind but an invalid payload is diagnosed without aborting verify_all, while database operational errors still propagate.
acceptance: A tamper regression replaces an authoritative completion's terminal origin payload with valid JSON of the wrong shape and requires verify_all to return an unhealthy report naming the invalid origin instead of returning StoreError::Json.
Diagnosis leaves stored schema and rows unchanged and unrelated SQLite errors still propagate; the ordinary typed loader and verification admission remain strict.
